answer: The warrant costs 2 years of work and 4000 mead audits per name — cheap once, ruinous at farm scale. You cannot borrow Easy packer warrant with packers attestation from a neighbour; a warrant packers renew after mead audits. The pigment proves the deed happened, the nectar proves it was dear, and the meadow proves it can be found again. A faker would have to earn all three from scratch.
